projects.name: twenty-crm-mcp-server
projects.author: mhenry3164
projects.desc: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Twenty CRM integration. Enables natural language interactions with your CRM data through Claude and other AI assistants. Supports CRUD operations, dynamic schema discovery, and advanced search across people, companies, tasks, and notes.
projects.long1: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Twenty CRM integration. Enables natural language interactions with your CRM data through Claude and other AI assistants. Supports CRUD operations, dynamic schema discovery, and advanced search across people, companies, tasks, and notes. Maintained by mhenry3164 on GitHub, where it has earned 102 stars from the community.
projects.long2: It's actively developed around ai-assistant, claude, crm, and is a solid reference for anyone building with these tools.
